title: Linear Regression (Closed Form)
signature: def fit_linear_regression(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> tuple
hints: Absorb the bias into the weights: append a column of ones to X.
The least-squares solution of A theta = y solves the normal equations A^T A theta = A^T y.
Don't invert A^T A. It is singular when columns are linearly dependent. np.linalg.lstsq returns the minimum-norm solution in every case.
